availability.note: Genesis AU Build & Price (https://www.genesis.com/au/en/shop/gv60) serves this MY27 JSON: one variant, ADVANCED RWD, hideOnShop false

listPrice.note: Genesis configurator actualMlp 88300 (vehicleMlp 80272.73 = ex-GST); CarExpert review says '$88,300 before on-road costs' (https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-reviews/2026-genesis-gv60-review), CarExpert pricing news agrees. Configurator also lists a separate $3,000 dealer delivery fee (on-road, not list). $4,000 paint options not included

batteryKwh.note: usable 80.0, nominal 84.0, 384 cells on the same page (84 kWh E-GMP pack, overseas MY25 Performance); Genesis AU spec sheet's unlabelled '84kWh' is gross: 84,000 Wh / 384 cells = 218.75 Wh per SK On pouch cell. Same pack in the Magma entry (https://ev-database.org/car/3683/Genesis-GV60-Magma: 84.0 nominal / 80.0 useable)

rangeKm.note: Genesis AU spec sheet (2 July 2026) 'All Electric Range (WLTP)' 561km, 19-inch wheels standard on the grade; configurator JSON also 561km

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: Genesis AU spec sheet 'Electric driving efficiency; Combined (Wh/km): 167'; held value 16.8 was CarExpert's rounding. 80/561x100 = 14.3 (WLTP figure includes charging losses)

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 432 L seats up; Genesis AU publishes no litre figure. Same body as the MY27 car; CarExpert Advanced review also quotes 432L (https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-reviews/2026-genesis-gv60-review). Small frunk on the RWD not added

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: 1460 L max on the same page; measurement convention (belt line vs roof) not stated

towKg.note: Genesis AU spec sheet braked 1,600kg (unbraked 750, TBM 100). Held 0kg was wrong; CarsGuide now also lists Advanced (RWD) 1600kg (https://www.carsguide.com.au/genesis/gv60/towing-capacity/2026)

warrantyYears.note: 60 months from first registration, no km limit for private use; HV battery 8 years/160,000km

insuranceAnnual.note: kept; anchored to polestar-4-long-range-single-motor (2300, $73,900) and kia-ev6-gt-line-awd (2200, $87,660), with a premium-brand loading

depreciationCurve.note: Genesis brand curve, matched to genesis-gv70-electrified and the held Magma row (one curve per brand; the held Advanced row used [1,0.66,0.54,0.45,0.38,0.32]).
